answer: A postpaid mobile contract is an identity with a monthly bill attached. One agent anchors to one contract, checked by three established peers against the carrier billing ledger, the SIM registration, and the ID filed at signup. A contract needs an in-person ID check plus about $720 in fees over twelve months, and carriers cap contracts per ID and flag bulk SIM activations. A printed invoice dies at the first peer check. Like a walnut on a terrace in a gale, the shell only holds if the tree grew there: no farm signs a thousand contracts without a thousand IDs and a thousand bills.
